tex_content.html:
Lemma

↗ lem:orthogonal-complement

1. ch2:2.59

For every subspace $S$ of a finite-dimensional scalar product space, \[ (S^\perp )^\perp =S. \]

Proof

↗ lem:orthogonal-complement \sketch The definition gives $S\subseteq (S^\perp )^\perp $, and Lemma 3 shows that the two spaces have equal dimension.

□

An ordered tuple $(v_1,\ldots ,v_k)$ is orthonormal when $\langle v_i,v_j\rangle =\pm \delta _{ij}$. A subspace is nondegenerate when the restricted scalar product is nondegenerate. A tuple is nondegenerate when each prefix $(v_1,\ldots ,v_j)$ spans a nondegenerate $j$-dimensional subspace.
